description: Result of migrating each frozen fixture with the production AppDatabase at schema v7, and of restoring each golden backup with the production DriftBackupRepository.importJson into a fresh v7 database that holds one sentinel measurement (the migration code as of the commit that added these artefacts). Frozen evidence: never regenerate.
normalisation: Row digests cover every column of every table (storage type and value), plus sqlite_sequence. Rows are sorted by their serialised text, so rowid order is ignored. The only normalised value is legacy_quarantine.quarantined_at: an ISO-8601 UTC text that does not start with "2026-02-01T10:" (the fixtures own stamps) was written by the migration from the wall clock and is replaced by "<migration-time>"; any other value is kept.
schema: table_info, index_list (+ index columns), foreign_key_list, CHECK clauses and full CREATE text per table, stored index SQL, triggers and views. All SQL text goes through normaliseSql (identifier quotes removed, whitespace around punctuation and operators removed).
